q1.q: Is this a chatbot with a script?
q1.a: No. It holds a real conversation, understands follow-up questions and answers the way your business would. No "press 1 for opening hours".

q2.q: Does it tell people it is an AI?
q2.a: Yes, in the first sentence. The law requires it, and we think it is simply honest. Then it gets on with helping.

q3.q: What if it does not know the answer?
q3.a: It says so and passes the question to you with the customer’s name and number, so you can call back. It never makes things up.

q4.q: How long before it is live?
q4.a: VangChat is usually live within a few working days. VangMessage and VangVoice take one to two weeks, because WhatsApp and phone forwarding need to be approved and set up.

q5.q: Does it work in French and English too?
q5.a: Yes. Dutch, French and English are standard, and it switches to the language the customer speaks.

q6.q: Do I keep my current phone number?
q6.a: Yes. Calls you do not pick up are forwarded to your assistant. Nothing changes for your customers.

q7.q: Do I need to be good with technology?
q7.a: No. We set everything up and keep it running. If you can send us a WhatsApp, you can work with us.

q8.q: Can I change what it says later?
q8.a: Yes. Send us your changes, like new prices, holiday hours or a new service, and we update it for you every week.

q9.a: Everything is handled under GDPR. Your customer data belongs to you and is never used to train other systems. Full explanation on

q10.a: From €50 a month for one channel, excl. VAT. The exact price depends on your business, and we give you a fixed price on a short call.

about.title: We build the front desk small businesses never had time for.
about.lead: Small businesses lose customers every day, not because they do bad work, but because nobody was free to answer. We fix that, without asking the owner to become a tech company.

mission.text: We build and personally set up one assistant that answers calls, WhatsApp messages and website chats for Belgian businesses, in the languages their customers actually speak, so the owner never has to configure or manage it.

vision.text: A Belgium where no small business, whatever its size or technical skill, loses a customer because nobody was available to answer.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: How VangAI handles personal data about the people who visit this website and contact us.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.text: VangAI, Hasselt, Belgium, company number [company number]. We are the controller for the personal data described on this page. For data about your customers, handled by your assistant, see Data & privacy.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.text: When you book a call or email us, we receive your name, business name, email address, phone number and whatever you choose to tell us about your business. This website does not use tracking or advertising cookies.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.text: To answer your question, prepare and hold the call you booked, send you a quote and, if you become a client, deliver our service. We do not sell your data and do not use it for anything else.

sections.title: Legal basis
sections.text: Taking steps at your request before entering into a contract, performing our contract with you, and our legitimate interest in answering business enquiries.

sections.title: Who we share it with
sections.text: Only the service providers we need to run our business, such as our booking tool and email provider. They process data on our instructions. [List of providers to confirm.]

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.text: Enquiries that do not lead to a contract are deleted after 12 months. Client records are kept as long as the contract runs and afterwards for as long as Belgian law requires. [Periods to confirm.]

sections.title: Your rights
sections.before: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, object to its use or ask for a copy. Email
sections.after: . You can also complain to the Belgian Data Protection Authority (Gegevensbeschermingsautoriteit).

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.lead: Which cookies this website uses and why.

sections.title: What cookies are
sections.text: Cookies are small files a website stores in your browser. Some are needed for the site to work, others track what you do. We only use what the site needs.

sections.title: What we use
sections.text: This website does not set analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. It remembers your language choice (Dutch, French or English) in your own browser, and nothing about that leaves your device.

sections.title: Booking a call
sections.text: When you click Book a call, you go to our booking tool. That tool may set its own cookies to make booking work. [Booking tool and its cookies to confirm.]

sections.title: Why there is no cookie banner
sections.text: Because we do not use non-essential cookies, there is nothing to ask permission for. If that changes, we will ask you first and update this page.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.lead: The agreement between VangAI and the businesses we work for.

sections.title: The service
sections.text: VangAI sets up and runs an assistant that answers phone calls, WhatsApp messages and website chats for your business. What is included is described in your quote and on the Pricing page.

sections.title: Prices and payment
sections.text: All prices are excluding VAT. You pay a one-off setup fee (on quote) and a fixed monthly price, invoiced monthly. There are no costs per call, message or booking.

sections.title: Term and cancellation
sections.text: The minimum term is 3 months. After that, the contract continues monthly and you can cancel with one month notice. [Notice period to confirm.]

sections.title: Your part
sections.text: You give us correct information about your business, prices and opening hours, and let us know when something changes. You stay responsible for the agreements you make with your customers.

sections.title: Our part
sections.text: We keep your assistant running, make your updates, and tell you honestly when something does not work. If the assistant cannot answer a question, it passes it on to you instead of guessing.

sections.title: Liability
sections.text: Our liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the three months before the event. [Clause to be reviewed by a lawyer.]

sections.title: Law and disputes
sections.text: Belgian law applies. Disputes go to the courts of Hasselt, after we have tried to solve it together first.

dataPrivacy.title: What happens to your customer conversations
dataPrivacy.lead: In plain language: what your assistant stores, why, where, for how long, and who owns it. Short answer: you do.

sections.title: What we store
sections.text: The conversations your assistant has with your customers: call recordings or transcripts, WhatsApp and chat messages, and the details customers share, such as their name, phone number and what they need. Plus the bookings it makes in your calendar.

sections.title: Why we store it
sections.text: So your assistant can do its job: book appointments, send you a summary, remember a customer across channels, and pass on questions it cannot answer. We also use it to write your monthly report. Nothing else.

sections.title: Where it is stored
sections.text: On servers inside the European Union. [Hosting provider and location to confirm.]

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.text: Conversations are kept for [period to confirm], then deleted automatically. Bookings stay in your own calendar for as long as you want them there.

sections.title: Who owns it
sections.text: You do. Your customer data belongs to your business, not to us. It is never sold and never used to train other systems. When you stop working with us, you choose: we send you an export, or we delete everything.

sections.title: Telling customers it is an assistant
sections.text: Your assistant says it is an AI in its first sentence. The law requires it, and we think it is simply honest.
